Hyperloop in India | India’s First Hyperloop Project | Future of Transportation
India is taking a big step towards the future with Hyperloop technology! This high-speed transport system can reach speeds of 1,000+ km/h, making travel faster than airplanes! IIT Madras and Indian Railways are working on India’s first Hyperloop project, and the country has already built Asia’s largest Hyperloop test track.
